Class Card

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.cards.Card
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
AbandonedShip, AbandonedStation, CombatZone, Enemies, Epidemic, MeteorSwarm, OpenSpace, Planets, StarDust
public abstract class Card extends Object implements Serializable
Abstract base class representing a card in the game. Cards define various events or encounters during gameplay.
